item.title: What Your Daily Fart Count Could Say About Your Health
item.description: Researchers want to establish a baseline range for daily fart count and gas content, which could help us discover more about the workings of the gut microbiome.

item.title: 6 Things to Know About Early Menopause
item.description: Early menopause may involve unexpected symptoms and health concerns. Here’s what it means, how it affects your health, and which treatments may help.

item.title: Can Essential Oils Help During Cancer Treatment?
item.description: Essential oils can help relieve cancer symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, pain, and insomnia. Learn more about their safety before giving them a try.

item.title: Blurred Vision: 14 Potential Causes (and When to See a Doctor)
item.description: Learn about causes of gradual and sudden-onset blurred vision, from eyestrain and refractive errors to cataracts and strokes, plus when to see a doctor.

item.title: Missed Period: Is It Perimenopause or Something Else?
item.description: Discover reasons for missed periods in your 40s, from perimenopause to stress, pregnancy, and health conditions. Learn signs and when to consult a doctor.

item.title: A Drug Combo That Includes a GLP-1 May Improve Psoriasis and Psoriatic Arthritis Symptoms
item.description: The results of 2 recent clinical trials combining the GLP-1 drug and the biologic reinforce the benefits of treating obesity and inflammation together.

item.title: Can Hair Loss Pills Cause Erectile Dysfunction?
item.description: The link between finasteride and erectile dysfunction is complex. Learn what research shows about hair loss pills and ED, plus safer alternatives and treatment options.

item.title: The Top Foods High in Vitamin C — and Why the Nutrient Is So Important
item.description: Vitamin C is an essential nutrient that plays a role in maintaining tissue, bone, and blood vessel health. You can find it in strawberries, oranges, bell peppers, and more. Get info on more top sources of vitamin C.

item.title: What Are Personalized Vitamins, and Do You Need Them?
item.description: Companies that craft custom vitamins based on the results of online, DNA, or blood tests have become popular. Here are their benefits and drawbacks.

item.title: 4 Health Benefits of Farting
item.description: Farting is a normal bodily function that can support digestion, reduce bloating, and signal gut health issues. Here’s a look at why farting is good for you.
